title: Quantitative ramification bound for a tame normalized tensor factor
statement: Let $B$ and $A$ be DVR domains [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], with $A$ a finite $B$-algebra [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Let $n,r>0$, assume $r$ is a unit in $B$, and assume $\mathfrak m_B A=\mathfrak m_A^n$. Let $E/\operatorname{Frac}(B)$ be finite separable [def-pc-field-extension, def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension], with its composite $B$-algebra structure. Let $C=\operatorname{integralClosure}_B(E)$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure] and assume $C$ is finite over $B$. For every prime $R$ of $C$ contracting to $\mathfrak m_B$, assume its ramification index and residue degree both divide $r$. For a maximal ideal $P$ of $D=E\otimes_B A$, put $F=D/P$, and assume the map $\alpha:A\to F$ induced by the right tensor inclusion is injective. Give $F$ this $A$-algebra structure and put $S=\operatorname{integralClosure}_A(F)$. Assume $S$ is finite over $A$. For every prime $Q$ of $S$ contracting to $\mathfrak m_A$, its ramification index, defined as the length of $S_Q/\mathfrak m_A S_Q$ over the localization $S_Q$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime], is at most $r/\gcd(r,n)$.

source.place: Tags 0BRM (lemma-abhyankar), 09EV (uniformizer-root DVR), 09EM (normalized tensor factors), 09E7 (weakly unramified criterion), 032L (finite separable normalization). Auxiliary-root argument deriving the quantitative bound from these lemmas.

proof.text: Set t=r/gcd(r,n). Positivity of r and gcd gives t>0. Factor n through gcd(r,n) and cancel the gcd in r to show r divides n*t.

Choose an irreducible uniformizer pi of A and form the explicit ring A1=A[X]/(X^t-pi). The existing root-algebra theorem gives its domain and DVR instances and its root-generated maximal ideal. Monicity gives finiteness and positive degree gives injectivity. Map the principal maximal ideal (pi) and use root^t=pi to obtain m_A A1=m_A1^t. Mapping the original maximal-ideal identity gives m_B A1=m_A1^(n*t).

Lift the chosen normalized tensor factor and Q through A1/A by the factor-lifting theorem. It supplies P1, finite normalization S1, the compatible embedding S -> S1, flatness, and a prime Q1 lying over Q and m_A1.
Since r divides n*t, apply the index-one Abhyankar theorem over B to A1, P1 and Q1 to get e(Q1/A1)=1.

Compute e(m_A1/A)=t directly by the length definition, mapping m_A A1=m_A1^t into the localization and using the DVR quotient-length formula. Torsion freedom makes S1 flat over A1. The A->A1->S1 tower gives e(Q1/A)=t; the A->S->S1 tower says e(Q/A) divides e(Q1/A). A positive integer is at least each divisor, hence e(Q/A)<=t. All tower and length facts are supplied by Mathlib.RingTheory.RamificationInertia.Ramification and Mathlib.RingTheory.Flat.TorsionFree.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09EV, 09EM, 032L, 0BRM and 09E7; Lean assembly of the explicit auxiliary-root extension and the two Mathlib ramification towers.

lean.statement:
theorem dvr_tame_tensor_factor_ramificationIdx_le
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    (n : ℕ) (hnpos : 0 < n) (r : ℕ) (hrpos : 0 < r) (hr : IsUnit (r : B))
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [Algebra B A] [Module.Finite B A]
    (hindex : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).map (algebraMap B A) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A ^ n)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (FractionRing B) E]
    (hE : FiniteDimensional (FractionRing B) E ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable (FractionRing B) E) :
    letI : Algebra B E :=
      ((algebraMap (FractionRing B) E).comp (algebraMap B (FractionRing B))).toAlgebra
    let C := integralClosure B E
    Module.Finite B C →
    (∀ (R : Ideal C) (hR : R.IsPrime),
      letI := hR
      R.comap (algebraMap B C) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B →
        R.ramificationIdx B ∣ r ∧ R.inertiaDeg B ∣ r) →
    let D := E ⊗[B] A
    ∀ (P : Ideal D) (hP : P.IsMaximal),
    let := hP
    let F := D ⧸ P
    let alpha : A →+* F := (Ideal.Quotient.mk P).comp
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[B] D).toRingHom
    letI := alpha.toAlgebra
    Function.Injective alpha →
    let S := integralClosure A F
    Module.Finite A S →
    ∀ (Q : Ideal S) (hQ : Q.IsPrime),
    let := hQ
    Q.comap (algebraMap A S) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A →
      Q.ramificationIdx A ≤ r / Nat.gcd r n
